business_model.core_description: Technology leader driving digital transformation of industries with history spanning more than 130 years

business_segments_2023.name: Electrification
business_segments_2023.description: Manufactures and sells electrical products and solutions providing safe, smart and sustainable electrical flow from substation to socket. Portfolio includes renewable power solutions, modular substation packages, distribution automation, switchboards, UPS solutions, circuit breakers, measuring devices, control products, wiring accessories, enclosures, cabling systems, and intelligent home and building solutions.

business_segments_2023.name: Motion
business_segments_2023.description: Designs, manufactures and sells drives, motors, generators and traction converters driving low-carbon future. Offers digital technology and related services enabling energy efficiency, safety, reliability and precise process control.

business_segments_2023.name: Process Automation
business_segments_2023.description: Offers integrated automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and marine industries. Portfolio includes control technologies, industrial software, advanced analytics, sensing and measurement technology, marine propulsion systems, and lifecycle services including remote monitoring, preventive maintenance, asset performance management, emission monitoring and cybersecurity.

business_segments_2023.name: Robotics & Discrete Automation
business_segments_2023.description: Provides industrial and collaborative robots, autonomous mobile robotics, mapping and navigation solutions, robotic solutions, field services, spare parts and digital services. Specializes in automation solutions based on programmable logic controllers, industrial PCs, servo motion, transport systems and machine vision.

business_segments_2023.name: E-mobility
business_segments_2023.description: Independent division as of January 1, 2023. Products included in scope of reporting.

business_segments_2019.name: Electrification
business_segments_2019.description: Manufactures and sells electrical products and solutions throughout electrical value chain. Serves customers in buildings, data centers, rail, wind and solar, power distribution, food and beverage, marine, oil and gas, and e-mobility.

business_segments_2019.name: Industrial Automation
business_segments_2019.description: Offers integrated automation, electrification and digitalization solutions for process and hybrid industries covering production processes, electrical and motion requirements, measurement and analytics, marine and turbocharging solutions.

business_segments_2019.name: Motion
business_segments_2019.description: Designs, manufactures and sells drives, motors, generators and power transmission solutions for energy efficiency and emission-free energy production.

business_segments_2019.name: Robotics & Discrete Automation
business_segments_2019.description: Provides industrial and collaborative robots, machine and factory automation solutions with programmable logic controllers, industrial PCs, servo motion, transport systems and machine vision.

ai_positioning.summary_fr: ABB se positionne comme intégrateur de l'IA dans ses solutions d'automatisation et sa plateforme numérique ABB Ability. L'entreprise déploie l'IA dans des applications spécifiques telles que le tri de déchets, l'assemblage assisté par IA avec 5G, et l'analyse prédictive pour l'optimisation des actifs. Son approche privilégie l'intégration de l'IA aux robots collaboratifs et aux systèmes d'automatisation existants plutôt que le développement de capacités IA fondamentales.
